leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a stack data structure to process Reverse Polish Notation expressions
Construct a function that iterates through tokens in a Reverse Polish Notation expression
Apply arithmetic operations based on operator tokens encountered during iteration
Manipulate stack elements by pushing operands and popping for calculations
Initialize and configure a solution that returns the final computed value
Integrate error handling for invalid expressions or division by zero scenarios
Control the flow of execution to ensure proper order of operations without parentheses
